## Implementation (engine model)

Base Split Shot resolves as a Projectile Attack (skill_resolver.py::_resolve_split_shot): per-level % Weapon Attack Damage (237% L1 → 347% L20), one additive `SkillHitForm` with hit_count=3 (1 base + intrinsic +2 Projectile Quantity), scales_with_projectiles=True, shotgun_falloff=0.77, and the new `ResolvedSkill.shotgun_requires_grant=True` flag (the skill 'cannot hit the same enemy' → NO Shotgun Effect by default). Spread vs Shotgun Effect are distinct: offense.py clamps a shotgun_requires_grant form's single-target hit count to 1 UNLESS `same_target_shotgun_grant` is present; then n_proj = 3 + projectile_quantity_flat and form_shotgun = 1 + (n-1)*(1-0.77) (falloff coefficient 77% = fraction LOST, engine convention matching Chromatic/Merge/Phantom — PROVISIONAL, re-verify in-game). Supports (skill_effects/split_shot.py, all four guarded; universal +20% rides the rank path): Diversion → projectile_quantity_flat+=5 + a plain +(11-13)% dmg_additional (stays spread); Volley → projectile_quantity_flat+=2, same_target_shotgun_grant=1 (grants Shotgun Effect), and (-39..-38)% dmg_additional; Collaboration → +roll(4.2-4.4%) x (2 + projectile_quantity_flat) as one dmg_additional factor, count = intrinsic 2 + all +Projectile Quantity except the base 1 (PROVISIONAL); Rapid Advance → installs ChanneledSpec(max_stacks=5, min_stacks=0, behavior='refresh') on the resolved skill + a per-additional-max-stack IntrinsicAdditional (per=0.225 on max_channeled_stacks_flat, cap 15 stacks), emits +100% attack_speed_additional and -50% dmg_additional, and returns add_mod_tags={'channeled'}. The channeled attack fires at the NORMAL WEAPON attack rate (weapon APS x gear x increased x additional attack speed, incl. the +100%) — it is an ATTACK, so it keys off ATTACK speed, not cast speed — hard-rounded to whole 30 Hz ticks (offense.py + engine/tick.py period_ticks/rate_from_ticks: rate = 30/N -> 30,15,10,7.5,6...). A stock 1.5 base weapon APS x (1+100%) = 3/s. No fixed channel base / persistent-entity attack_frequency (so the spell-style 'Channel Rate'/'Gale Attack Frequency' cast-speed rows do NOT render). channel_attack_ticks + channel_attack_to_next_{increased,additional} surface the breakpoint as 'Channel Attack Rate' + 'Attack Ticks' in the Channeled box (PlayerStatsScreen.tsx). On-kill extra projectiles (50%/8m/2 targets) are clear/AoE only -> NYI.
